boundary_decision.rationale: Observed prices, professional valuation conclusions and statistical price-index observations share a governed value-assertion envelope, but their authority, meaning, evidence and lifecycle remain explicitly typed and price-index production composes with Official Statistics.

decisions.rationale: A requested, quoted, administered, agreed, invoiced, paid, accounting, appraised, modelled or indexed amount must retain its own type and evidence even when numeric amounts coincide.
The value assertion owns the scoped subject and interest binding while assets, liabilities, rights, products and services retain their properties and lifecycle externally.
This model may observe commercial amounts but does not own negotiation, agreement, invoice, payment, delivery or legal-effect state transitions.
Gross, net, tax, subsidy, fee, discount, delivered, credit and unit views must preserve the original observed total and transformation lineage.
IFRS 13 supplies a measurement framework only when another applicable IFRS requires or permits fair value; it is not a universal synonym for market value or transaction price.
Software and model outputs retain parameters, testing and uncertainty, but professional-conformance claims require competent authority, judgement, scope, documentation and review.
Issue, correction, supersession, expiry and withdrawal create successor states with reason and authority and never erase the prior opinion or its permitted reliance.
Market, model and input uncertainty, sensitivity, scenario dispersion, confidence and materiality describe different properties and cannot collapse into one score.

decisions.disposition: accepted as specialization composed with WM-DAT-002
decisions.rationale: This model owns basket, price, weight and formula semantics while Official Statistics owns programme authority, general quality, release and observation-vintage governance.
An index observation is not an individual item's price, cost of living or universal inflation measure without its purpose, population, basket, weights, formula and periods.
Conversion preserves original amount and records rate authority, observation time, quotation direction, triangulation, precision and rounding rather than replacing the original.
The structure covers recognition, direct informational properties, evidence, methods, controlled actions, validation, provenance, access and lifecycle, but specialist profiles still need refinement.
